svg.title: Card fraud platform: system diagram, Layer 3
svg.desc: Deployable units of the LLM and agent platform and the data between them, numbered per flow. The gateway sits in the middle: the chat page and the agents call it from above, it calls the model router and the tool servers below.
svg.text: CARD FRAUD PLATFORM · SYSTEM DIAGRAM · LAYER 3
System diagram, Layer 3: every agent call goes into agentgateway first; what calls it sits above it, what it calls below.
the first stop of every agent call: it checks the caller's key, then routes
support staff, every question: NGINX -> agents -> MCP tools and the LLM
RAG data pipeline, per release: documents, chunks, vectors
developer push: Jenkins tests, builds, signs, deploys, evaluates
Numbers give the order inside each flow: A1 to A17 follow one question from support staff to the tools and the model.
Above the gateway: what calls it. Below it: what it calls. Under the cluster: the stores and model servers they read.
White box = one pod or container. Tag top left = where it runs: namespace (ns), compose profile, host or internet.
A sub-task goes from agent to agent (A2A), a tool call to a tool server (MCP), a prompt to the chat model (LLM route).
Each reply comes back on the same call and is not drawn.
Dotted frames: the three agents (A6-A9, C5, O5, O6 apply to each) and the three MCP servers
(one image, one Helm release each; A10, C4, O2 apply to each). Dashed boxes: support services.
NGINX also serves registry, grafana, logs, traces and the Web API (host api: card data
and policy chunks by id, from card-data-mcp, over HTTPS).
The Feast online store and the Fraud Scoring API are Layer 2 units, drawn again here because the tool servers call them (A11, A14).
